summary: c69 ignores the fence mask during nearby cap fallback, allowing fenced MAX_NEW_TOKENS examples to create false WARNs.
Numeric N in “re-gen at N×” arms c69 but can be discarded, causing non-default multipliers to be evaluated as 2×.
The report labels its 56-file pin sweep selector-wide, but the 192-file selector contains omitted direct rule/skill pin consumers.
Adjudicated non-blocking by the binding reconciler: plan v3 D1 specifies the unmasked raw-line cap window verbatim, so there is no fence-masked cap requirement to violate.
evidence: Mechanics CONFIRMED independently by the orchestrator (the window fallback iterates raw lines with no mask, while _c69_bounds_between filters on the mask) but the plan-adherence framing is refuted: plan v3 lines 245-249 specify the unmasked cap window verbatim, including a byte-identical code comment, and the fence-masked clause at MF1 binds BOUND attribution only. Kill criterion 1 not tripped: its own text defines a confirmed false positive as an OBSERVED corpus-re-scan WARN on satisfied arithmetic, and all three independent 4484-plan scans (implementer, Codex, Claude) returned exactly the registered 11-WARN set with zero FPs. Remains a real latent design gap in the APPROVED plan, recorded as a Standing recommendation on PASS with Codex's fixture proposal; not an implementer deviation and not a bounce.

summary: Adjudicated non-blocking by the binding reconciler: the no-capture composition IS the calibrated path producing 8 of the 11 registered WARNs; changing it is a plan amendment, not a fix.
evidence: Mechanics CONFIRMED independently by the orchestrator (alt-3 consumes the multiplier without a capture group; the mult regex lookahead misses, so a non-2x shorthand falls to the 2.0 default). Refuted as a blocker on two grounds. (1) Plan v3 section 11 entry 20 documents the behavior verbatim, reconciler-executed and harness-corroborated at plan time, so it was specified and approved. (2) The reconciler executed the shipped regexes and established that the flagged composition IS the calibrated path producing 8 of the 11 registered corpus WARNs (the #2225 v6-v13 arm-2 set), pinned by the plan grammar decision plus test 18 — so Codex's proposed grammar change would invalidate the registered census and is must-ask plan-amendment territory, never an implementer bounce. Real latent limitation, carried as a Standing recommendation.
